customManagers.description: Track Cuttlefish .deb versions in PKGBUILDs against Google's apt repository

description: Renovate can bump pkgver, but the Artifact Registry filename carries an
opaque hash and the .deb checksum is obviously not derivable from a
version number. This resolves both from the upstream package index.
Requires self-hosted Renovate: `commands` are validated against
`allowedCommands`, which is a self-hosted-only admin option.

packageRules.description: Cuttlefish upgrades land as one PR; they are released together
